entries.subject: Placement

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.776 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 185144: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.254 +/- 0.012 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 0.776 +/- 0.008 (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/746/1/101). entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 185144: 168-1020 nm, cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 2261614264931057664 (6 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffebdb. Routes tried in order: pulkovo: found, not needed after the colour and its cross-check; kiehling: HR 7462 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 7462 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 7462 is not in part2; stis-ngsl: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,255 K and log g 4.56 (u1 0.585, u2 0.175): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 4.56 from 2025A&A...698A..93J; the 58 published values span log g 4.2 to 4.67, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
